title: Day 412
style: cinematic sci-fi realism, anamorphic lens look, dusty orange Martian light, fine film grain
negative: blurry, distorted hands, extra fingers, cartoon, text, watermark, subtitles, logo
continuity: Mars surface at sunrise, low sun, orange-pink sky, thin dust haze
White and orange spacesuit with a gold reflective visor, the face is never visible
The sprout is tiny and bright green, the only green thing in the landscape

astronautkinja.name: The astronaut
astronautkinja.description: lone astronaut in a bulky white spacesuit with orange shoulder panels, small mission patch on the left arm, white gloves with orange fingertips, helmet with a gold reflective visor that hides the face

shots.location_description: vast red Martian desert at sunrise, rocky dunes, the astronaut small in the lower third of the frame, huge pink sky above
shots.action: 0-2 s: the astronaut kneels in the red sand; 2-5 s: she presses a tiny green sprout into the soil and gently pats the sand around it

dialogue.text: Day four hundred twelve. First plant on Mars.

shots.location_description: macro view at ground level on the red Martian surface
shots.action: 0-2 s: the tiny green sprout is in sharp focus with a white and orange gloved hand resting beside it, far behind it a blurry red shape in the soft orange background; 2-4 s: focus shifts to the background and reveals a tall blooming red flower next to an old rusty watering can half buried in the sand; 4-5 s: the gloved hand freezes
